name: Employees and supervisors cannot access HR-only screens

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'flow.access@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Access is denied: the response is a 403 forbidden error page, NOT the HR approval queue.
Access is denied with a 403 forbidden error page, NOT the All Requests screen.
Click the 'Log out' icon button, then log in with email 'empty.supervisor@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
Access is denied with a 403 forbidden error page, NOT the HR approval queue.
The export endpoint responds with a 403 forbidden error (company-wide data must not be downloadable by a supervisor).
